problem:
The number of insects in a controlled habitat $H(t)$ after $t$ months can be modeled by the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}H}{\text{d}t}=2H.
$$

If there are currently $120$ insects in the habitat, calculate the number of insects after $2$ months. Round your answer to the nearest integer.

The number of insects after $2$ months is approximately 
{{field-1}}
insects.
